newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Sydney Casino still confident on tax deal.
newsitem.headline: Sydney Casino still confident on tax deal.

text.p: Sydney Harbour Casino Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it was still confident of recieving a tax concession for high roller gamblers from the New South Wales (NSW) government.
"I think the government will come to that (approval) decision soon," casino chairman Dick Warburton told reporters after the company's annual meeting.

Sydney Harbour Casino (SHC), which has a 12-year monopoly to operate the only legal casino in Australia's largest city, has battled with the NSW government for the past 18 months to get a similar tax rate to other Australian casinos.

Sydney Harbour Casino is seeking a 10 percent tax rate concession for high roller gamblers from the government, a rate enjoyed by rival casino operators Crown Ltd, Jupiters Ltd and Burswood Property Trust.

Australia's most well-known gambler Kerry Packer plans to buy management control of the Sydney casino, through his media group Publishing and Broadcasting Ltd (PBL), but the deal has still to be approved by casino regulatory authorities.
Warburton said PBL's planned acqusition of management control at the casino should not affect the government's decision.
